name: run_ledger_contract_multiplier_1000
description: A 1000x contract-multiplier instrument (1000SHIB style): fee, funding and unrealized all use qty*mult*price, so a unit price move is multiplied by 1000.
derivation: initial wallet 1000. SHIB1000 mult=1000, step 1. FILL +3 @0.02 fee_rate=0.0005 slip=0: exec=0.02; notional=3*1000*0.02=60; fee=60*0.0005=0.03; wallet=999.97; entry=0.02; mark=0.02; u=3*1000*(0.02-0.02)=0; equity=999.97. MARK 0.021: u=3*1000*(0.021-0.02)=3000*0.001=3.0; wallet stays 999.97; equity=1002.97. FUNDING rate=0.0002 mark_price=0.021: signed notional=3*1000*0.021=63; cashflow=-63*0.0002=-0.0126; wallet=999.97-0.0126=999.9574; funding_cum=-0.0126; mark stays 0.021; u=3.0; equity=1002.9574. Final: wallet 999.9574, unrealized 3.0, equity 1002.9574, realized 0, fees 0.03, funding -0.0126, position +3. Without the multiplier fee would be 0.00003 and unrealized 0.003, so the numbers pin the multiplier.
